C0026.title: Hangzhou Police Seize 3 Tons of Counterfeit West Lake Longjing Tea Worth 120 Million Yuan
C0026.summary: Hangzhou police cracked a case involving counterfeit West Lake Longjing tea, seizing 3 tons of fake tea with a total value of 120 million yuan. The perpetrators produced and sold counterfeit products to unfairly seize market share from genuine sellers, seriously infringing on the legitimate rights and interests of businesses and consumers and disrupting fair market competition.
